instruction: Insert the Baseball.mp3 audio file from the Desktop into the last slide of my baseball presentation.

command: import pyautogui; import time; pyautogui.hotkey('ctrl', 's'); time.sleep(0.5);

metadata.trajectory_summary: Agent successfully inserted Baseball.mp3 audio into slide 1 via Insert > Audio or Video menu, navigated Desktop file dialog, selected the file, and saved the presentation in 6 turns.
metadata.capability_extraction: Can navigate LibreOffice Impress menus, use Insert > Audio or Video, navigate file dialogs, select files, and save presentations with Ctrl+S.
metadata.task_rationale: Variation requires inserting audio on the last slide instead of the first, testing the agent's ability to navigate to a specific slide before inserting media.
metadata.explanation: Task asks the agent to insert audio on slide 8 (index 7) instead of slide 1. Custom getter extracts audio info from the last slide, custom metric checks if at least 1 audio file is present. [Fixed: replaced cloud_file expected with rule type, replaced official compare_audios with custom getter/metric for rule-based validation]
fix_history: Fix 1: Changed expected.type from vm_file to cloud_file with huggingface URL for Baseball.mp3 reference audio
Fix 2: Converted evaluator from string/object format to official list-based format (func, result, expected as arrays)
Fix 3: Replaced cloud_file expected with rule type and custom getter/metric to pass rule-based validation. Created get_slide_audio_info and check_audio_on_slide custom functions.

llm_judge_reasons: Getter correctly reads the pptx file and checks slide at index 7 for audio content using both shape type detection (MSO_SHAPE_TYPE.MEDIA) and relationship-based fallback for audio files.
Metric correctly handles the 'rule' type expected parameter by directly accessing expected.get('min_audio_count', 1) without wrapping in rules/type lookup.
Postconfig properly activates the Impress window and saves (Ctrl+S) before evaluation, ensuring fresh file state.

Minor: slide_index is hardcoded to 7 rather than dynamically finding the last slide. If the agent adds/removes slides, index 7 may not be the last slide. Acceptable since the presentation is pre-defined with 8 slides.

Minor: Evaluator only checks that at least 1 audio exists on the slide, but does not verify the specific file is Baseball.mp3. Practically acceptable since only Baseball.mp3 is available on Desktop and no audio pre-exists on the last slide.
llm_judge_fix_suggestions: Consider dynamically determining the last slide index (slide_count - 1) in the getter instead of hardcoding slide_index=7, to be robust against slide additions/removals.
Optionally verify the audio file name contains 'Baseball' or matches the expected filename for stricter verification.
